author: Louis contributors
description:
Louis is a Make Your Own (MYO) client for Yoto: search YouTube, arrange playlists, and save them to your Yoto account.

Before connecting Yoto, register this redirect URI on [yoto.dev](https://yoto.dev/get-started/start-here/):

`http://<your-casaos-host>:4000/api/yoto/auth/callback`

Open Louis at your NAS hostname or LAN IP — not `localhost` from other devices. YouTube API key is optional (yt-dlp search works without one).

tips.en_US:
1. Set **LOUIS_YOTO_CLIENT_ID** in app settings after install.
2. Register the redirect URI above on yoto.dev (use your real host/IP).
3. Optional **LOUIS_YOUTUBE_API_KEY** for faster search.
4. Health check: `http://<host>:4000/api/health`
